comment:
* A source that keeps a buffer internally so that callers can do small reads
 * without a performance penalty. It also allows clients to read ahead,
 * buffering as much as necessary before consuming input.
 * @hide This class is not part of the Android public SDK API

methods.name: Buffer buffer()
methods.comment: Returns this source's internal buffer.

methods.name: boolean exhausted() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns true if there are no more bytes in this source. This will block
   * until there are bytes to read or the source is definitely exhausted.

methods.name: void require(long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns when the buffer contains at least {@code byteCount} bytes. Throws
   * an {@link java.io.EOFException} if the source is exhausted before the
   * required bytes can be read.

methods.name: boolean request(long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns true when the buffer contains at least {@code byteCount} bytes,
   * expanding it as necessary. Returns false if the source is exhausted before
   * the requested bytes can be read.

methods.name: byte readByte() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes a byte from this source and returns it.

methods.name: short readShort() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes two bytes from this source and returns a big-endian short.

methods.name: short readShortLe() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes two bytes from this source and returns a little-endian short.

methods.name: int readInt() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes four bytes from this source and returns a big-endian int.

methods.name: int readIntLe() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes four bytes from this source and returns a little-endian int.

methods.name: long readLong() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes eight bytes from this source and returns a big-endian long.

methods.name: long readLongLe() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes eight bytes from this source and returns a little-endian long.

methods.name: long readDecimalLong() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads a long from this source in signed decimal form (i.e., as a string in base 10 with
   * optional leading '-'). This will iterate until a non-digit character is found.
   *
   * @throws NumberFormatException if the found digits do not fit into a {@code long} or a decimal
   * number was not present.

methods.name: long readHexadecimalUnsignedLong() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads a long form this source in hexadecimal form (i.e., as a string in base 16). This will
   * iterate until a non-hexadecimal character is found.
   *
   * @throws NumberFormatException if the found hexadecimal does not fit into a {@code long} or
   * hexadecimal was not found.

methods.name: void skip(long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Reads and discards {@code byteCount} bytes from this source. Throws an
   * {@link java.io.EOFException} if the source is exhausted before the
   * requested bytes can be skipped.

methods.name: ByteString readByteString() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes all bytes bytes from this and returns them as a byte string.

methods.name: ByteString readByteString(long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes {@code byteCount} bytes from this and returns them as a byte string.

methods.name: byte[] readByteArray() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes all bytes from this and returns them as a byte array.

methods.name: byte[] readByteArray(long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes {@code byteCount} bytes from this and returns them as a byte array.

methods.name: int read(byte[] sink) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes up to {@code sink.length} bytes from this and copies them into {@code sink}.
   * Returns the number of bytes read, or -1 if this source is exhausted.

methods.name: void readFully(byte[] sink) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes exactly {@code sink.length} bytes from this and copies them into {@code sink}.
   * Throws an {@link java.io.EOFException} if the requested number of bytes cannot be read.

methods.name: int read(byte[] sink, int offset, int byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes up to {@code byteCount} bytes from this and copies them into {@code sink} at
   * {@code offset}. Returns the number of bytes read, or -1 if this source is exhausted.

methods.name: void readFully(Buffer sink, long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes exactly {@code byteCount} bytes from this and appends them to
   * {@code sink}. Throws an {@link java.io.EOFException} if the requested
   * number of bytes cannot be read.

methods.name: long readAll(Sink sink) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes all bytes from this and appends them to {@code sink}. Returns the
   * total number of bytes written to {@code sink} which will be 0 if this is
   * exhausted.

methods.name: String readUtf8() throws IOException
methods.comment: Removes all bytes from this, decodes them as UTF-8, and returns the string.

methods.name: String readUtf8(long byteCount) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes {@code byteCount} bytes from this, decodes them as UTF-8, and
   * returns the string.

methods.name: String readUtf8Line() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes and returns characters up to but not including the next line break. * A line break is either {@code "\n"} or {@code "\r\n"}; these characters are * not included in the result. * *

On the end of the stream this method returns null, just * like {@link java.io.BufferedReader}. If the source doesn't end with a line * break then an implicit line break is assumed. Null is returned once the * source is exhausted. Use this for human-generated data, where a trailing * line break is optional.

methods.name: String readUtf8LineStrict() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes and returns characters up to but not including the next line break. * A line break is either {@code "\n"} or {@code "\r\n"}; these characters are * not included in the result. * *

On the end of the stream this method throws. Every call * must consume either '\r\n' or '\n'. If these characters are absent in the * stream, an {@link java.io.EOFException} is thrown. Use this for * machine-generated data where a missing line break implies truncated input.

methods.name: int readUtf8CodePoint() throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes and returns a single UTF-8 code point, reading between 1 and 4 bytes as necessary. * *

If this source is exhausted before a complete code point can be read, this throws an {@link * java.io.EOFException} and consumes no input. * *

If this source doesn't start with a properly-encoded UTF-8 code point, this method will * remove 1 or more non-UTF-8 bytes and return the replacement character ({@code U+FFFD}). This * covers encoding problems (the input is not properly-encoded UTF-8), characters out of range * (beyond the 0x10ffff limit of Unicode), code points for UTF-16 surrogates (U+d800..U+dfff) and * overlong encodings (such as {@code 0xc080} for the NUL character in modified UTF-8).

methods.name: String readString(Charset charset) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes all bytes from this, decodes them as {@code charset}, and returns
   * the string.

methods.name: String readString(long byteCount, Charset charset) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Removes {@code byteCount} bytes from this, decodes them as {@code charset},
   * and returns the string.

methods.name: long indexOf(byte b) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first {@code b} in the buffer. This expands the
   * buffer as necessary until {@code b} is found. This reads an unbounded
   * number of bytes into the buffer. Returns -1 if the stream is exhausted
   * before the requested byte is found.

methods.name: long indexOf(byte b, long fromIndex) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first {@code b} in the buffer at or after {@code
   * fromIndex}. This expands the buffer as necessary until {@code b} is found.
   * This reads an unbounded number of bytes into the buffer. Returns -1 if the
   * stream is exhausted before the requested byte is found.

methods.name: long indexOf(ByteString bytes) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first match for {@code bytes} in the buffer. This expands the buffer
   * as necessary until {@code bytes} is found. This reads an unbounded number of bytes into the
   * buffer. Returns -1 if the stream is exhausted before the requested bytes are found.

methods.name: long indexOf(ByteString bytes, long fromIndex) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first match for {@code bytes} in the buffer at or after {@code
   * fromIndex}. This expands the buffer as necessary until {@code bytes} is found. This reads an
   * unbounded number of bytes into the buffer. Returns -1 if the stream is exhausted before the
   * requested bytes are found.

methods.name: long indexOfElement(ByteString targetBytes) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first byte in {@code targetBytes} in the buffer.
   * This expands the buffer as necessary until a target byte is found. This
   * reads an unbounded number of bytes into the buffer. Returns -1 if the
   * stream is exhausted before the requested byte is found.

methods.name: long indexOfElement(ByteString targetBytes, long fromIndex) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Returns the index of the first byte in {@code targetBytes} in the buffer
   * at or after {@code fromIndex}. This expands the buffer as necessary until
   * a target byte is found. This reads an unbounded number of bytes into the
   * buffer. Returns -1 if the stream is exhausted before the requested byte is
   * found.

methods.name: InputStream inputStream()
methods.comment: Returns an input stream that reads from this source.

methodNames: int read(byte[] sink, int offset, int byteCount) throws IOException
void readFully(Buffer sink, long byteCount) throws IOException
String readString(long byteCount, Charset charset) throws IOException
long indexOf(byte b, long fromIndex) throws IOException
long indexOf(ByteString bytes, long fromIndex) throws IOException
long indexOfElement(ByteString targetBytes, long fromIndex) throws IOException
